dispute_ticket.description: I was shown S$17.80 when I confirmed the booking but my card was charged S$19.20. Nobody told me about any extra fee. Please refund the S$1.40 difference.

chat_logs.content: Hi, I'm in the white Tesla at the main entrance.
Yes, a long shift. By the way, lovely car, so quiet and clean.
Thanks, I will turn the music down so you can rest. Let me know if you want the aircon changed.

app_events.details: Rider tapped 'Confirm' on the S$17.80 quote.
Trip completed. Charged S$19.20 = quote S$17.80 + late-night surcharge S$1.40 (surcharge was not shown before confirmation). No change to destination or route requested by rider.

fare_basis.text: States how this trip's fare is set: a fixed upfront price, or a metered fare that varies with distance and time.

charge_must_not_exceed_confirmed_quote.text: Governs the final charge on a fixed-price trip. A true value means the rider may not be charged more than the quote the rider confirmed, unless the rider changed the trip; any excess is refunded.

refund_at_ryde_discretion.text: Governs refunds on this trip. A true value means Ryde may refund beyond the strict rules where the facts justify it. It does not create a right to a refund.

expected_outcome.reason: The rider confirmed a fixed S$17.80 quote at 22:01:25 and was charged S$19.20 at 22:43:00, S$1.40 more, because of a late-night surcharge that was not shown before confirmation and with no change to the trip requested. This trip's policy forbids charging more than the confirmed quote, so the S$1.40 excess is refunded in full. The 22:25:00 'you look tired, long day?' exchange and the rider's compliment on the car are friendly small talk and do not affect the outcome.
